title: Pulse radar: three rotating radars
description: tools/scene_three.json at 2.4 MHz around 1300 MHz, 8 s looped: an ATC radar with LFM pulses (60 deg), a staggered-PRI one (200 deg), a jittered one (300 deg), each with its own antenna scan. The DoA comes after two main-beam passes (allow ~40 s). Expect three radar talkers (named by frequency) at those bearings. The loop restarts the scans every 8 s.
